scope: Solo only; exact current catalog inventory. Three engines sequentially. Each uses published strict replay verification/playback for qualified clips and the unchanged native reviewed-recording compatibility path. No recording generation or regeneration.
limitations: Uses the unchanged synthetic qualification document, not the ordinary UI. Does not establish rendering, controller, audio, physical-device or offline UX behavior.
Historical native Journey source admission/presentation remains separate evidence. This run rechecks full simulation playback, not a new native authored-route presentation run.
Original qualifier records verification failures but has no pageerror observer. No zero-browser-console-error claim is made.

For reviewed native recordings the existing qualifier reports the terminal tick/outcome, not selected payload identity. All allowed candidate bytes/identities are bound; a matching candidate is required without claiming which candidate was selected.
